_meta.purpose: Executable scoring model for product/provider match ranking, confidence adjustment, manual review, and recommendation output.

records.calculation: Before scoring, exclude product if active_status != active, explicit exclusion flag is true, geography not served, industry restricted, product disqualifier directly conflicts, or borrower fails a non-waivable product-level minimum.
Credit pass 30, revenue pass 30, TIB pass 20, geography pass 10, entity/sole-prop/startup pass 10. Hard required rules can force score to 0.
records.override_notes: Use product qualification first; if null use provider_defaults; if null use family_defaults.

records.calculation: Use fundability_score plus product-specific compensators. Revenue-first products give extra credit for bankability; credit-first products give extra credit for credit readiness; asset-first gives extra credit for collateral/docs.
records.override_notes: Family appetite changes weight within fundability; not a hard qualification pass.

records.calculation: 100 direct product/family match, 75 adjacent use case, 50 unclear but plausible, 25 weak, 0 incompatible.
records.override_notes: If product use_case_ids are populated, use them before family defaults.

records.calculation: Start 100; subtract risk flag penalties. Critical conflict can force exclusion. High conflicts require manual review. Product-specific tolerances can reduce penalty only if source-backed.
records.override_notes: Never waive a disqualifier unless product/provider record explicitly supports the exception.

records.calculation: 100 if borrower has required product docs; 75 if major docs ready; 50 if bank statements only; 25 minimal docs; 0 required docs unavailable.
records.override_notes: Product docs override family-level document assumptions.

records.calculation: If urgency high: instant/24h=100, 1-3d=90, 3-10d=70, 2-4w=40, 1-3m=15. If urgency low, speed contributes less and does not penalize slower products heavily.
records.override_notes: Do not over-rank fast expensive products when urgency is low.
manual_review_triggers: borrower asks for same-day but only structured products fit

records.calculation: 100 if state/country explicitly served; 70 if national/US assumed from source; 40 unknown; 0 not served.
Use provider operational referral_priority / affiliate_status / monetization weight. Default 50 when unknown. Never outrank eligibility or risk.
records.override_notes: Relationship priority is a tie-breaker, not an eligibility lever.
manual_review_triggers: affiliate status missing for otherwise strong match

records.calculation: Apply confidence multiplier after weighted score: borrower data confidence + product verification status + source confidence + conflict status.
records.override_notes: A verified product receives slight bonus; conflicting criteria receive meaningful penalty and manual review.

records.calculation: weighted_score = Σ(component_score * weight); adjusted_score = weighted_score * confidence_multiplier + verification_bonus_penalty; sort descending; suppress excluded products; show top 3 plus fallback/prep route.
records.override_notes: Use family-specific weights when applicable; otherwise global weights.
